name: spotter
description: Spotter: a Claude Code dashboard by Steady Matter. It watches the work and counts the steps. A progress bar above the prompt, a row per helper agent with a pixel Pal that hatches and grows as the agent works, and a headline for the last reply. Built on Flightdeck by Stephen Casella (MIT); the bar's look is adapted from savvy-progress by johnnyvizz. The Pals are unofficial Palworld fan art, not affiliated with Pocketpair.

motion.description: Let the Pals hop while their agent works, or keep them still
